translating business priorities, Procurement challenges, technology trends and customer needs into strategic priorities, target pictures and actionable roadmaps* Connect strategic and operational Procurement with digital transformation, identifying opportunities where digital, AI and new ways of working can simplify processes, improve decisions and create measurable business value* Drive strategic initiatives from concept toward execution, developing recommendations, business cases and decision papers and translating strategic priorities into pragmatic initiatives together with Procurement and DTO stakeholders* Drive Customer Success for strategic digital initiatives and products, building strong relationships with internal customers, understanding their outcomes, challenges and emerging needs, and ensuring that strategic ambition translates into sustainable business value* Use customer insights, adoption, business outcomes and market developments to challenge and improve our direction, creating a systematic feedback loop between Procurement reality, digital products, the portfolio and DTO strategy* Collaborate across DTO and Procurement to connect strategy with execution, particularly with Transformation & Customer Success, Product Management, Rollout and other teams, ensuring alignment from strategic intent through adoption and value realizationWhat You
